mule.description:
Universal SOQL Query Engine — accepts any SOQL query from any layer, validates it, checks circuit breaker, executes against Salesforce, and returns normalized JSON with pagination metadata.
Features: - SOQL injection prevention (blocks DML, comments, multi-statement) - Query complexity scoring with warnings - Auto-pagination for large result sets - Consistent response envelope - Full audit trail

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dwl::QueryGuardrails --- validateSoql(payload.soql, p('query.max.soql-length') as Number)
%dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dwl::QueryGuardrails --- if (!isEmpty(trim(payload.soql default ""))) queryComplexity(payload.soql) else { score: 0, warnings: [] }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Correlation-Id": correlationId, "X-Query-Complexity": vars.queryComplexity.score as String default "0" }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dwl::AuditLogger --- buildAuditLog('INFO', 'query', 'SOQL', sizeOf(payload.data.records default []), vars.requestStartTime, correlationId, attributes)]

validation:is-not-blank-string.message: SOSL search string is required and cannot be blank

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dwl::SfdcResponseNormalizer --- wrapSearchResponse(payload, correlationId, p('sfdc.api.version'))

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dwl::AuditLogger --- buildAuditLog('INFO', 'search', 'SOSL', sizeOf(payload.data.records default []), vars.requestStartTime, correlationId, attributes)]
